repository_role: Official resource repository for Audiobook Cutter Studio

files.role: Bundled command-line backend resource for Audiobook Cutter Studio
files.source: Built from ffmpeg tag n8.0.1 using build-ffmpeg-apple-darwin.sh and build-ffmpeg-deps.sh in this repository
files.notes: Mach-O arm64 executable. Local -version output reports ffmpeg n8.0.1. Build scripts pin lame 3.100 and opus 1.5.2. Minimal static build focused on local file processing with selected demuxers, muxers, decoders, encoders, and speech-oriented filters including libmp3lame.

files.notes: PE32+ x86_64 executable. Build scripts pin ffmpeg n8.0.1, lame 3.100, and opus 1.5.2.
